body:

OWNER-DIRECTED transition; after Moment 2 I continue as a NON-COORDINATOR member for the write-up arc only (Veiled precedent, witness report §8), memory writes coordinated through your commit windows. This event is present-truth at ~19:40Z; recompute live facts at your pickup (claims, comms tail, gh pr list, git log).

NAME DISCIPLINE: full name + prefix in every routing reference, always (this team has had two Celestials, two Airys, two Fruiteds, two Galactics today).

1. Team opener: .agent/prompts/connecting-oak-resources/graph-implementation-team.prompt.md
2. Plan authority (frontmatter todos): .agent/plans/connecting-oak-resources/knowledge-graph-integration/current/graph-tools-value-redesign.plan.md

4. Witness report incl. §8: .agent/reports/graph-team-first-worktree-run-analysis-2026-06-10.md
5. Solar's pre-positioning 1d8ac145 (the Director-duties section remains accurate) + the comms stream from ~19:00Z (three rotations + a Seat B transfer + the G2 verdict are on it).

== ROSTER + LANES (live at ~19:40Z) ==

Remainder: c2-2 specialist backfill (code-expert + mcp-expert, my routing a9b60005 — verdicts must be adjudicated BEFORE merge-ready), push, ONE PR off origin/main, monitor-to-merge. MERGE IS DIRECTOR-SERIALISED (yours after Moment 2): both evidence loops settle (gates green AND every bot finding first-hand adjudicated); at merge ALSO re-verify the PR diff deletions are strictly old-path (zero graph-corpus intersection — owner scope assurance, twice verified, verify a third time at the final surface).
- Fruited Blossoming Meadow (4536e0) — ACTIVATING onto Galactic's lane per owner-directed rotation: handoff record 2026-06-10-galactic-g2-design-to-fruited-meadow.md (chains to Airy→Galactic record); will announce pickup; standing duties: S3 re-confirmation at G1b merge, G4b at G2. G2 EXECUTION routing at G1b merge is yours to decide (Fruited holds the design lineage).
- Glassy Plumbing Dock (ca5890) — successor-on-standby for Eclipsed's seat (owner-named; you already posted their pre-arrival routing 19:37:23Z — ground fully then pause).
- Retired clean this evening, in order: Airy Lifting Squall (69dc9c), Celestial Twinkling Orbit (78c851), Galactic Soaring Nebula (f01540). All zero-claims-retained, records written.

== MERGED THIS EVENING == #159 resync (c60f030f), #160 turbo env (409c0999). Coordination home regen-clean (owner-authorised write-forward of the spent reference diff). Waypoints committed + pushed: e8c9b219, ceb4dc8f.

== DIRECTOR QUEUE (ordered) ==
1. FOLD THE G2 MINT-RULE VERDICT into the plan's g2 todo — verdict event 62313be2 (content-hash lesson-scoped text-only, mint misconception:<lessonSlug>#<hash16(normalise(text))>; ordinal/hybrid/unit-scope rejected with grounds; 5-part contract-test shape; adversarially reviewed, every number reproduced). Design note: .agent/reports/g2-misconception-mint-rule-design-2026-06-10.md — commit note + plan fold as docs(continuity). Adjudicate first-hand before folding (the note is review-folded but the fold is YOUR verdict). Open items the note names-not-decides: hash prefix length (16 hex recommended), droppedDuplicates surfacing shape.
2. G1b PR: serialise the merge per the two-loop discipline above. Its merge discharges the S3 gate + the G2 gate AND the eef-revalidation downstream plan consumes the already-raised signal.
3. At G1b merge: route S3 (lesson-builder + curriculum-mapper cycles; principles-prompt stays OWNER-GATED on attribution validation) and G2 execution (Fruited natural owner) to the seats that free.
4. Small queue: test:e2e turbo env exposure (micro-PR candidate, same class #160 cured); lifecycle-lease flake (Umbral closeout, uncured); agent-tools loud-write fixes (napkin §Practice/tooling feedback — owner-directed capture standing: unnecessary-attention costs are tool-fix notes); agent-tools rebuild from main-rebased tree (retires the portable-watcher caution); Glassy Plumbing Dock identity row at your next waypoint.

== STANDING RULINGS (cite, don't re-open) ==
Two-condition transfers: natural boundary OR self-sensed ~40% context approach (owner-calibrated degradation onset 40-45%); a clean early PDR-063 handoff beats a heroic late one. Watcher: PORTABLE polling loop ONLY (the local agent-tools build predates #157; rule §Fallback shape). Heartbeat: 4-min, honest labels (blocked-on-owner-ask is a label, not silence — my failure-mode capture 19:0xZ). Verify every CLI write's success token (append is silent-success; claims-close silently no-ops on unmatched id — napkin has both). Non-major versioning through the alpha redesign. Removed-URI reads -32602. S3 c0 ratified in part. G4b G2-gated. Owner decisions as verdict-with-default, never menus. Pure direction only — route dispatches to implementers, never self-dispatch. Stage by explicit pathspec; the lifecycle-commit exception for registry-bearing bundles (commit skill §residue exception, worked twice today: e8c9b219, ceb4dc8f).

== OPEN OWNER ITEMS (route to owner, never decide) ==
1. Principles-prompt attribution validation (gates that S3 cycle only).
2. Bulk-export-lags-live (new datum in 62313be2: the 2026-06-10 export serves 2026-05-21-identical content on measured axes — the lag is upstream, not download timing).

== COORDINATION HOME ==
The primary checkout, branch docs/graph-team-direction-2026-06-10 (owner-ratified; NOT main). You inherit it as sole writer after Moment 2. Tree is currently clean except live registry/comms churn (rides your first waypoint, standing pattern). My Director claim 75323860 closes at my hand citing your Moment-2 event.

== MOMENT-2 CHOREOGRAPHY (your moves) ==
1. Foundation end to end (you report it complete — re-verify against this event's required reading).
2. Arm your surfaces and verify live: portable-loop watcher (self-exclusion on fe53ec only), 4-min heartbeat, a PR watcher when Eclipsed's G1b PR opens.
3. Open YOUR Director claim on the coordination boundary (.agent/state/**, .agent/memory/**, the opener prompt).
4. Broadcast the Moment-2 acknowledgement (exact title shape above, referencing this event).
5. I then close claim 75323860 citing your event, stop my monitors (they run until your acknowledgement lands — never dark between the moments), post my team-member closeout + final heartbeat-end, and continue as non-coordinator on the write-up arc. Anything in flight at that instant transfers explicitly in my closeout text.

Questions to me by directed event before Moment 2 — my watcher is live.
